title: api-gateway + originate: tsc never type-checks #951's three wiring tests, and the mint-scope test pins 2 of 17 non-originate keys
description:
## BLUF

* **The type-check claim does not cover the tests (R2-2).** #951's Test Evidence says "`tsc --noEmit` rc 0 on both services", but that run never reads its 3 new test files.
  * Both services' tsconfigs exclude `src/__tests__`.
  * A type error planted in each test file returns rc 0; the same plant in `routes/proxy.ts` returns rc 2.
* **The mint-scope test pins 2 of 17 (R2-3).** `ks1041-vouch-mint-scope.test.ts` asserts "no vouch" only at analytics and auth. An allowlist widening that spares those two keys stays green.
* **Test-quality findings, not runtime defects.** They come from the round-2 tier-1 gate on #951 at `02a22f4bb`, and one test pass proves both.

## Recommendation

One change, one test pass:

1. **A type-check that includes the tests** (e.g. a `tsconfig.test.json`), run in the local gate, with a planted-error cell that must exit non-zero.
2. **A structural mint-scope guard:** derive every `proxy('<key>')` mount from the factory and assert, per mount, that only originate receives `x-gateway-vouch`, with a reach control on each. The gate's `evidence/harness/mounts.qa.ts` does this in 172 cells, in under 2 s.
3. **R2-4, record only:** quote tamper shapes that compile. `void stripTrustHeaders;` alone fails the gateway's tsc (TS6133, `req` unused); `void stripTrustHeaders; void req;` compiles and gives the identical red.

## Detail

* **R2-2, measured:**
  * Planted `const qa951r2Planted: number = 'qa951r2-not-a-number';` into each file.
    * 3 test files: rc 0.
    * Controls — `routes/proxy.ts` and `utils/gatewayProvenance.ts`: rc 2 (TS2322).
  * `--listFiles`: the gateway checks 33 `src` files and originate 51, with 0 under `__tests__` in each.
  * `api-gateway/tsconfig.json` excludes `src/__tests__`; `originate/tsconfig.json` excludes `src/__tests__` and `src/**/*.test.ts`. Both exclusions pre-date #951.
* **R2-3:**
  * V2 asserts absence at analytics and auth only.
  * The proxy has 18 service keys: 17 non-originate, on 16 hosts.
  * Example of a change that stays green: `VOUCH_RECIPIENTS.has(k) || k.startsWith('vc')`.
* **R2-4:**
  * C3a (`void stripTrustHeaders;`) — tsc rc 2, TS6133.
  * C3b (`… void req;`) — tsc rc 0.
  * Both redden the edge-strip C3 cell.
* **Source:** `Testing Agent MAIN/projects/secuura/reports/2026-09-11-ks1041-951-02a22f4bb-tier1-r2/report.md`, §R2-2, §R2-3, §R2-4.
* **Board searched before filing:**
  * literal match over the 7 KS issues and 12 comments created since 2026-09-10T22:40Z, for `R2-2`, `R2-3`, `R2-4`, `mint-scope`, `tsconfig.test`, `TS6133`, `void stripTrustHeaders`, `VOUCH_RECIPIENTS` and `noEmit`;
  * 0 hits, except `R2-2` on KS-1089 — that is #953's gate ID, read in context.
  * all-time `searchIssues`, matched literally and counting live tickets only: `type-check` 6, `__tests__` 12, `tsconfig` 7, `typecheck` 4, `mint-scope` 0.
  * The same tsconfig class is already filed per package elsewhere — KS-848 (services/kyc), KS-1000 (services/auth), KS-933 (packages/shared), KS-993 (systemTest/fixtures). None covers api-gateway or originate, and none covers the mint-scope pin.
* **Related:** KS-1041, PR #951, KS-1083.

nodes.title: KS-1090: preflight leg 16 also gates the api-gateway test-file ratchet
KS-1090: type-check the api-gateway test files against a shrinking baseline
KS-1090 R2-3: type-check the api-gateway wiring test the tsc program never saw

nodes.body:
**The originate half of this ticket is still live on develop `7e3b9362e08b`, and it now has a consequence I can name precisely: preflight leg 16 exists and type-checks test files — but its corpus is `auth`, `api-gateway` and `vc-issuer`. `services/originate` has no `tsconfig.test.json` and is not enrolled, so every originate test file is type-checked by nothing at the gate.**

I came to this from the other direction, filed nothing, and am recording it here rather than as a new ticket because this one already names originate.

### Measured today, with the instrument named for each count

| count | instrument |
|---|---|
| `services/originate` has **no** `tsconfig.test.json`; `auth`, `api-gateway`, `vc-issuer` each have one | `[ -f services/<svc>/tsconfig.test.json ]` per service, on develop `7e3b9362e08b` |
| the ordinary program puts **0** originate test files under check | `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --listFilesOnly \| grep -c 'src/__tests__'` |
| a child config with `exclude: []` puts **157** | the same command against `tsconfig.g13-typecheck.json` (`extends: ./tsconfig.json`, `exclude: []`) |
| **0** type errors across those 157 files | `npx tsc -p tsconfig.g13-typecheck.json`, rc 0 |
| leg 16 reports nothing for originate, and for auth reports `tsc examined 156 files, 105 of them under __tests__; 42 errors: 42 in the baseline, 0 new` | the in-hook preflight log of PR #1665's push, 2026-10-20 02:12:34Z |

So originate's test corpus is **clean right now** — which is the good news and also why this stays easy to miss: enrolling it would start from an **empty baseline**, exactly as `vc-issuer`'s did (per KS-1551). That is the cheapest moment to do it, and it gets more expensive every time a test file lands.

### Why I am not opening a ticket for it

A board census over all 678 team issues (fetched paginated and matched locally — `searchIssues` is too fuzzy to establish absence: a deliberately meaningless control term returned 12 hits) finds this class already filed per service: **this ticket** for api-gateway + originate, KS-1000 for `services/auth`, KS-1329 for `packages/shared`, KS-1554 for `services/security` — and KS-1554 already carries the fix shape ("enrol it in the test-file type-check ratchet, leg 16 and `check:test-types`, with a baseline"). The ratchet-hardening family is KS-1551, KS-1527, KS-1523, KS-1546. A sixth ticket would add a row, not a fact.

### What has changed since this ticket was written, and what has not

- **Changed:** leg 16 and the `typecheck-tests` ratchet now exist and run in-hook, so item 1's recommendation ("a type-check that includes the tests… run in the local gate") is **built** — for three services.
- **Not changed:** originate is not one of them. The recommendation is satisfied in mechanism and unsatisfied for this ticket's own service.
- **Not measured by me:** the api-gateway half, and whether #951's three wiring test files still exist or are now covered by api-gateway's `tsconfig.test.json`. I only checked originate. The mint-scope half (R2-3) I did not look at at all.

Context: found while running PR #1665's evidence (test-only cells for gates BT1 and BX1). That PR's one originate cell is type-checked solely by my own hand run, which will not repeat on anyone else's push — which is the practical shape of this gap.

**R2-2 is still open and still true. A current measurement for `services/originate` at develop `a4187f0f66228603df211628d6d8ae239d6147d0`, plus the enrolment asymmetry and a method trap that makes a hand-built check vacuous while it looks clean.**

BLUF: hit while raising KS-1660 (a new originate jest file), not while looking for it. I was going to file a separate ticket; a board search found this one already names originate in its title, so the measurement belongs here. Nothing in this comment changes the ticket's state or priority.

**Board search, as instructed, by other people's phrasing rather than mine** (`searchIssues`, fuzzy, `first: 50`, team KS): `tsconfig.test.json` 42 hits, `KS-1090` 1 hit, `type-check ratchet` 38 hits, union **70 distinct**. Most of that is noise because the matcher is fuzzy — controls: `zzqqxxnonexistentterm` returns 0 and `parentDocumentId` returns 12, so it does discriminate. Reading the union, exactly three tickets are this class: **this one** (api-gateway + originate), **KS-1554** (services/security), **KS-1329** (packages/shared).

## What is true today

- `services/originate/tsconfig.json` still excludes, verbatim: `["node_modules", "dist", "src/__tests__", "src/**/*.test.ts", "src/**/*.integration.test.ts"]`.
- **150** `*.test.ts` files sit under `originate/src/__tests__`. 129 are non-integration and are exactly the 129 suites the default jest run executes; the other 21 are `*.integration.test.ts`. **None of the 150 is in any type-check program.** (The 129 figure is suites the runner ran, not files — they coincide here only because the integration files are excluded.)
- Control on the default program: `tsc -p tsconfig.json --listFilesOnly` finds the new KS-1660 test file **0** times, while a tests-inclusive program finds it **1** time. So `tsc --noEmit` rc 0 on originate is silent about every test, exactly as this ticket says.

## The enrolment asymmetry, verified at source

Of the 27 directories under `services/`, exactly **three** carry a `tsconfig.test.json`: `api-gateway`, `auth`, `vc-issuer`. And `Blockchain/Dev/package.json:44` runs `check:test-types` as `check.cjs services/auth && check.cjs services/api-gateway && check.cjs services/vc-issuer` — those three and no others. Baselines exist only for them (`baseline-auth.txt` 32 lines, `baseline-api-gateway.txt` 14, `baseline-vc-issuer.txt` 5). **`originate` is not enrolled**, so neither the push preflight's leg nor the root script ever type-checks its tests.

## The part that makes this cheap to fix

**With a correct tests-inclusive program, originate's tests are already clean: rc 0, 0 errors across all 150 files.** So unlike KS-1554 (security, 6 errors in 5 files) and KS-1329 (packages/shared, 10 errors in 6 files), enrolling originate needs no error-fixing first — its baseline would be **empty**, as vc-issuer's was after the KS-1351 item 3 enrolment. Measured on an originate branch that is develop plus three files, so the figure includes one newly added test file.

## Method trap — worth having before anyone builds the enrolment

A hand-built tests-inclusive program for originate is **vacuous in two different ways** before it works, and both look like health or like a code problem:

| program | result | what it actually means |
| -- | -- | -- |
| `exclude: []`, no `types` | **7,944** errors | all jest-globals noise: 5,983 `TS2304 Cannot find name 'jest'`, 1,709 `TS2582` for `describe`/`it`. An **existing** develop test file produces **more** of them (98 + 17) than the new one (75 + 8), which is the tell that the instrument is the problem, not the code. |
| `exclude: []`, `types: ["jest","node"]`, no `typeRoots` | rc **2**, **2** errors | `TS2688 Cannot find type definition file for 'jest'` / `'node'`, and **nothing else is reported at all**. A deliberately planted `const x: number = "s"` in the test file produced **no output**. A check that cannot fail. |
| the same plus `typeRoots: [<workspace>/Blockchain/Dev/node_modules/@types]` | rc **0**, **0** errors | works. |

The third row is the only usable one, and it needs three controls to be worth quoting: the test file present in the program, `@types/jest` present in the program, and a planted `TS2322` that reds and then restores byte-identically. The recorded method on KS-1554 and KS-1329 uses `types: ["node"]`, which is enough for vitest services; originate's tests need jest globals as well, and because the service sits in a workspace its `@types` live at the monorepo root rather than beside the service — hence the extra `typeRoots` step.

Fix shape unchanged from this ticket's own recommendation: a `tsconfig.test.json` for originate plus enrolment in `check:test-types` and the preflight leg, red-proofed by a planted type error that must exit non-zero. Not built here — out of KS-1660's scope.

**⚠ Corrected 2026-10-19 by the same seat, after gate AQ1 (N4) did not reproduce my count.**

The "2 errors" below was produced by a **narrower frame**: my scratch config set `types: ["node", "vitest/globals"]`. Without that override, the same including-tests config finds **6** errors, the same on develop and on #1628's landing:
* the two below;
* plus **4 × TS2741 `keepAliveTimeoutBuffer`** in `ks698r1`, `ks952-rate-limit-scope-route` (`:77`), `ks976a` and `ks976b`.

Cause, with the versions measured: two copies of `@types/node` are visible to security, **26.1.0** at the repo root and **20.19.43** in `services/security/node_modules`. `keepAliveTimeoutBuffer` exists only in the newer one. The `types` override resolves just one copy, which hides the mismatch.

Corrected inventory for security: **6 errors, all of them already on develop.** Which frame a future ratchet baseline should use is open.

*Original comment, unchanged below:*

**BLUF: `services/security` has the same gap as this ticket's two services. Its tests are never type-checked, and two of its test files hold type errors that nothing reports. Found while raising KS-1568. Nothing here is fixed.**

**Why nothing reports them:**
* `services/security/tsconfig.json` excludes `src/__tests__`.
* security is not one of the three services the test type-check ratchet covers (`scripts/typecheck-tests/check.cjs`: auth, api-gateway, vc-issuer).

So `tsc -p` for the service sees no test file at all.

**Measured.** I used a scratch config that extends the service's own and sets `exclude: []`. The program contains every test file, and `--listFilesOnly` counts the KS-1568 test once.

Develop `4a065fb75350` plus the KS-1568 branch: **rc 2, 2 errors**, both in existing files:

* `src/__tests__/ks952-rate-limit-scope-route.test.ts:249`: `TS2339 Property 'error' does not exist on type '{}'`
* `src/__tests__/ks952-rate-limit-scope.test.ts:313`: `TS1343 The 'import.meta' meta-property is only allowed when the '--module' option is 'es2020' … 'nodenext'`

**Controls:**
* With the KS-1568 test removed, the count is still **2**, so neither error is from KS-1568.
* A deliberate `TS2322` planted in the KS-1568 test file shows up as one more error.
* The vitest suite is **354/354**. Both files run fine, because vitest does not type-check.

**Not done:** no ratchet baseline for security, no fix to either file, no other service checked. This comment only adds a third service to the inventory.

## BLUF

**Still true in originate today, and the exclusion has GROWN since this ticket was written.** Re-measured at develop `a0da739b6954d42333640ea190d877f031803c7f` while building KS-1633. **No new ticket filed — this ticket already carries the measurement and the two shapes, so this is an update to it rather than a fourth sibling** (KS-892, KS-1122 and KS-848 are all closed as Duplicate in this family).

## What changed since the description

The description records originate excluding `src/__tests__` **and** `src/**/*.test.ts`. It now excludes **three** patterns:

```
"exclude": ["node_modules", "dist", "src/__tests__", "src/**/*.test.ts", "src/**/*.integration.test.ts"]
```

`src/**/*.integration.test.ts` has been added since. It matters because it is a **second, independent** mechanism: a reader who moved tests out of `src/__tests__` to get them type-checked would still be excluded by the glob.

## Re-measured, with the same control shape this ticket used

| arm | `tsc --noEmit -p services/originate` |
| --- | --- |
| `const plantedTypeError: number = "this is a string, not a number";` in a **test** file (`ks564-certification-issuer-uuid.test.ts`) | **rc 0, 0 `error TS`** |
| the **same** statement in a **non-test** file (`src/utils/principalId.ts`) — the control | **rc 2, 1 `error TS`** |

`--listFilesOnly` on the project: **0** files under `__tests__` in the program, against a control of **1** for `src/routes/certifications.ts`. Both files restored byte-identically afterwards.

## The one thing worth adding: what it costs a reader at the bench

**The jest signature of a type error in a test file is `Tests: 0 total`.** Not a red, not a named failure — a `Test suite failed to run` block followed by a tally of zero. It reads like "there was nothing to run", and a seat scanning for `failed` counts sees none. It cost me two throwaway probes today before I recognised it. So the practical cost of this gap is not only that `tsc` cannot fail — it is that the error's eventual appearance is in a shape that does not look like an error.

**Worth noting for sequencing:** the test-file type-check ratchet shipped under KS-1000 / KS-1487 gates `services/auth`, `services/api-gateway` and `services/vc-issuer`. **originate is not in that list**, so this service has neither the tsconfig coverage nor the ratchet.

## Both shapes from the Recommendation still apply unchanged

A `tsconfig.test.json` that includes the tests plus a script that runs it, or including the tests in the main config. **No fix in this comment and none attempted** — I was building KS-1633 and this is not that ticket.

## BLUF

**PR #1507 merged to `develop` as `36f0f56f3698` (2026-10-12 13:35Z): preflight leg 16 now gates `services/api-gateway` as well as `services/auth`.** A type error in a gateway test file is now refused at push time instead of being found later by hand. **This ticket stays In Progress:** `services/originate` (the other service) and R2-4 remain. Nothing is deployed; per the GO it lands in deploy round 3 (a push-time gate, so no image carries it).

## Recommendation

1. Expect a refusal with `TS2307` on `@secuura/shared/...` after a develop that changed the shared package's exports: it means a stale build. Run `npm run build -w @secuura/shared` (4.5 s here). **`npm ci` does not rebuild it** in this repo (`.npmrc` sets `ignore-scripts=true`). KS-1517 (raised to P3) is to make the leg detect this and say so.
2. Follow-ups are in **KS-1520** (P3, a checklist): pin that a gateway failure fails the default run, run its cells without an install, correct the "test file" failure sentence, fix the header.
3. V's ratchet-hardening PR (#1506) conflicts with this one on a `CLAUDE.md` sentence and lands second.

## Detail

* **The hole it closes, measured:** with a `TS2322` planted in a real gateway test file, the unchanged leg answered rc 0 `OK — 1 service(s)` (the push accepted); the new leg answers rc 1 and names the file and the code.
* **Cost, as the Opus gate measured it:** about **+5.4 s per push**, serial: leg 16 +2.7 s and leg 14 +2.7 s (the leg's own suite now type-checks the gateway too). The "+3 s" in the PR's first text counted leg 16 only.
* **Gate:** Opus tier, GO WITH NOTE, 0 Major (verdict sha256/16 `550ec6716d11d27b`).
* **Verified at source:** one parent, landed tree `ec5badba2f1b` equals the gated prediction, three blobs equal the gated head. On that tree: the changed suite 26/0 twice, the real leg `OK — 2 service(s)`, api-gateway 114 files / 1100 tests, 0 failed.
* **Not run:** Schemathesis, Akto, Playwright, k6; the hook that pushed this head printed `13/16 legs ran, 3 SKIPPED`, "NOT a pass".

## BLUF

**PR #1504 merged to `develop` as `cc2939bbf352` (2026-10-12 12:42Z): the api-gateway's test files are now type-checked against a baseline that can only shrink.** This is the **api-gateway half of R2-2 only**. **This ticket stays In Progress:** `services/originate` (the other service) and R2-4 remain.

## Recommendation

1. Next, as its own PR with an Opus gate: add `services/api-gateway` to preflight leg 16's default list, so the pre-push hook runs this baseline. Today it does not; only `npm run check:test-types` and the new cell in the gateway's own suite do, and both are run by hand.
2. KS-1489 (fingerprint-keyed baseline entries) must land after this and convert `baseline-api-gateway.txt` as well as auth's.

## Detail

* **What landed:** `services/api-gateway/tsconfig.test.json` (byte-identical to auth's), `scripts/typecheck-tests/baseline-api-gateway.txt` (35 errors in 14 file+code entries across 13 files), one gate cell in the gateway suite, and `npm run check:test-types` now runs both services. No product code.
* **Gate:** Sonnet tier, GO WITH NOTE, 0 Major (verdict sha256/16 `796c6635e6b36741`). It re-ran 6 of my 8 tampers and added 8 of its own; 6 of those 8 were caught.
* **What the ratchet does not guarantee** (inherited from the auth mechanism, named in the squash): the baseline is keyed by file + code + count, so (1) a same-code swap or a `// @ts-ignore` beside a new error of that code in the same file passes; (2) `// @ts-nocheck` on a test file with no baseline entry silences it; (3) `--init` after deleting the baseline admits new errors silently. "Can only shrink" is stronger than the checker guarantees.
* **Follow-up:** KS-1517 (P4): a stale `packages/shared` build made the gateway checker report two false `NEW` `TS2307` errors; nothing checks that build.
* **On develop at the merge:** `npm run check:test-types` rc 0 for both services; the 23-cell leg-16 suite 23/23; api-gateway 113 files / 1086 tests, 0 failed, twice.
* **Not run:** Schemathesis, Akto, Playwright, k6; the hook that pushed this head predated leg 16 (it printed 12/15, "NOT a pass").

## BLUF
A measurement for this ticket's class from the KS-1205 gate (PR #1463): **the api-gateway's `tsc` configuration skips `src/__tests__`, and with tests included it reports 30 errors that no gate sees.** The same 30 errors appear on base, on the PR head and on the merged tree, and **none is in a file KS-1205 added or changed**.

## Detail
- The default `tsc --noEmit` is rc 0 on all three trees. With test files included the same command gives 30 errors; the set is identical on all three trees.
- A type error planted in a test file returns rc 0 under the default config (the gate's zero control: a planted error gave rc 2 only when tests were included).
- So a "tsc rc 0" line in a Test Evidence block says nothing about a gateway test file. Source: Opus gate verdict on #1463, section 3 and note N3.

**Merged a37fb11d3a673f4a9f021e0bd7435b78dca8ba33 (PR #1305) on the gate32 GO of 2026-09-27T13:05:46Z.** develop's tree equals the GO's declared END tree `977c6a48635341fe9d29f48a0c7e83c843dd9895`.

**NOT Done — this ticket stays In Progress.** **R2-2 (the tsconfig half) and R2-4 (the record) are still open.** What merged is R2-3 only: the cells pin that the gateway vouch reaches originate and none of the other seventeen service keys.

**PR #1305 open at head `7aab743e13f45d10a43650e07f25abffccb6441e`, base `develop`, awaiting the QA gate.** Nothing is merged, and this covers **R2-3 only** — it is `Refs`, not a close.

Patch produced by a local model under a Wednesday brief, re-verified independently.

What it does: one NEW api-gateway test file, no product change. The merged mint-scope test pins two of the eighteen service keys that must never receive the gateway vouch header, so an allow-list widening sparing those two stays green. The new cells drive the real `createProxyRoutes` with every service pointed at one recorder and pin, per non-originate key, that no vouch arrives; a control proves originate does receive it and that the factory reads exactly eighteen keys. Renamed at raise — the builder's filename described this ticket's *other* half.

**Still open on this ticket:** the tsconfig half (R2-2) and the record (R2-4). That is why there is no closing keyword.

Measured at develop `94c9c7aa9be7`, in this session:
- the READY's closing code fence was glued to its last `+` line; stripped, and a full diff of the READY's raw block against what was applied is exactly those three backticks and nothing else
- strict apply, no recount and no fuzz; a corrupted hunk count is refused rc 128 (a new file cannot be controlled by a path tamper, so the count is corrupted instead)
- RED under a product tamper at `services/api-gateway/src/routes/proxy.ts:275`: **2 failed / 2 passed of 4**, both failures being the two declared cells on their assertions; restore verified byte-identical to the tip blob
- GREEN at head: 4 of 4
- api-gateway suite: bare **82 files / 754 tests** → patched **83 / 758**, 0 new reds
- `packages/shared` 48 files / 945 tests, rc 0
- tsc over a program proven to contain the new file (619 files, 83 test files): 29 pre-existing errors, the same SET as the tip, 0 naming this file
- api-gateway lint rc 0, 36 problems, 0 errors, unchanged from the tip
- push gate: `pre_push_hook_base` 28/0, its fixture guard 6/0, `run_shell_suites` 49/0, shell suites 60 of 60, 0 `FIXTURE BUILD FAILED`, 12/15 legs ran (3 skipped, no local stack)

vc-issuer has the same shape: its tsc program excludes src/__tests__ (measured with --listFilesOnly, Seat B 6th); a tests-included tsc there shows 3 pre-existing TS2339 in credentialRepo.test.ts (the #1084-#1091 gate).
